item.title: Digitization of Historical Atmospheric Electricity Records from Lerwick Observatory (1927–1956) using Citizen Science
item.description:
Digitization of Historical Atmospheric Electricity Records from Lerwick Observatory (1927–1956) using Citizen Science
Hripsime Mkrtchyan, Keri A. Nicoll, R. Giles Harrison, and Anna Hovhannisyan
Earth Syst. Sci. Data Discuss., https://doi.org/10.5194/essd-2026-749,2026
Preprint under review for ESSD (discussion: open, 0 comments)
This paper presents the rescue of thirty years of handwritten atmospheric electric field records from a remote Lerwick observatory in Shetland. Nearly two thousand volunteers helped read and digitize the old paper sheets online. The result is a rare, long-term dataset showing how atmospheric electricity changes through the day and across seasons, supporting future climate research and showing how public participation can bring forgotten historical data back to life.
